== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Zenith Devices]] are a collection of seven highly advanced pieces of [[Aethertech]] created by humans during the ancient [[Zenith Era]]. Though often regarded as myths, these artifacts possess immense power capable of violating the laws of reality by bending space and folding dimensions. Their precise functions are adaptive, as their specific capabilities change based on the individuals who wield them. While they were originally designed for utility to help galactic civilization flourish, they are also characterized by significant personalities, often displaying ego, competitiveness, or even petty jealousy. Notable examples of these devices include [[The Last Horizon]], a starship that functions as a single device and maintains a symbiotic relationship with a crew of six; the [[Zenith Colony]], known as [[Shadow Ark]]; the [[Zenith Cannon]], which can appear as a standard [[plasma pistol]]; and the [[Zenith Blade]], which possesses the ability to remotely hijack ships and processors. Other mentioned devices include a unique staff named [[Eurias]] and a [[Zenith Processor]]. While many scholars doubted their continued existence, recent events have confirmed that all seven devices have been awakened.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Regarded as mythical treasures from an era beyond reliable history, [[Zenith Devices]] represent the original form of [[Aethertech]]. These powerful objects or entities are capable of utilizing conjuration spells and possess strength that might challenge even the staff [[Eurias]]. Within certain contexts, such technology serves as a prize in a contest or acts as the power source for a simulation.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|A [[Zenith]] Device is a high-level artifact or machine that can be active throughout the galaxy, though its existence has never been proven in any of the narrator's other lives. These entities may not be limited to biological laws and are capable of folding dimensions by bending the [[Aether]] to violate space. Possessing heavy pride and magical resistance strong enough to fracture a seal, such a device was once accessed by [[Starhammer]]. One specific example is a chunk of obsidian shaped like a cut diamond, while the [[Zenith Blade]] remains a potential device located halfway across the galaxy.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|A [[Zenith]] Device is a self-aware entity that achieves consciousness once specific awakening conditions are met. While these devices do not actively seek out partners, they possess the ability to evaluate qualifications and choose their own [[Champions]]. Once a selection is made, the device provides resources to a member of the Vallenar lineage. Furthermore, a [[Zenith]] Device is unable to lower its established standards, even as [[Benri Vallenar]] pursues the potential awakening of another such entity.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A [[Zenith]] Device is a powerful piece of ancient human technology that can manifest as an AI projection of yellow lights or a voice, such as the one that contacted [[Doctor Oladyne]]. While these devices possess basic functions and can be modified, their exact powers depend on specific tasks and users, allowing them to be brought to full power or even stand against the eyes of [[Solstice]]. Throughout various conflicts, these objects have been utilized by individuals like [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]] and [[Aila Escalon]], appearing in locations ranging from the [[The Last Horizon|Last Horizon]] to the [[Universal Manufacturing]] cargo ship. Whether acting as the [[Zenith Blade]], causing skills to rust, or filling a laboratory with musical laughter, these devices remain versatile tools capable of personal interest in others.}}
